text:
maya: Quick sync — I'm consolidating the safety matrix for the tenant-priority routing experiment. Need final rules for tiebreakers + clear rollback triggers before PRD sign-off.

devin: +1. Current open Qs: how do we break ties when two models have similar perf but different cost? Also how strict should the error-rate delta be for auto-rollback?

jordan: My proposal: tiebreaker order = 1) SLA tier (enterprise > standard), 2) customer pin requests, 3) observed quality regressions (human evals), 4) cost. That keeps critical customers protected.

elaine: Related: we need exact numeric thresholds in the PRD. I suggest rollback when paired z-score of error rate > 2 AND relative latency p50 increases > 20% for 3 consecutive windows (5m windows).

sahil: That feels a bit brittle for short spikes. Can we add a minimum sample size and hysteresis? e.g., only evaluate after 30m at each exposure level and require metrics hold for 2 windows.

devin: Agreed on hysteresis. Draft rule: evaluate every 15m, require 2 consecutive failing evaluations (so ~30m), and minimum 1000 requests in that window. If failure -> immediate rollback to last pinned model.

maya: Summarize acceptance criteria I'm going to put in PRD:
- Canary schedule: 5% (30m) -> 25% (60m) -> 60% (60m) -> 100% (30m)
- Metrics checked at each step: error_rate, latency_p50, latency_p95, synthetic-quality-score
- Automatic rollback if (error_rate_delta >= 1.5%) OR (latency_p50 relative increase >= 20%) persists for 2 consecutive checks with >=1000 reqs per check
- Manual gate for enterprise tenants: don't move beyond 25% without explicit product sign-off

jordan: Good. What about experiment tiebreaker automation? If two model variants both pass metrics but capacity/nodes differ, we should prefer lower-cost variant unless enterprise pin exists.

elaine: Also need edge-case: partial region failure. If region A fails but global metrics ok, we should isolate region and roll back there only. Add region-scoped rollback.

sahil: Add a fallback rule for KV-cache mismatch: if cache hit rate drops > 30% and regen latency increases, prefer model variant with compatible KV layout even if slightly costlier.

maya: I'll add these to PRD. Small snippet to include in rollout-config example: 
```yaml
canary:
  steps:
    - pct: 5
      min_time: 1800
    - pct: 25
      min_time: 3600
    - pct: 60
      min_time: 3600
    - pct: 100
      min_time: 1800
rollback_criteria:
  error_rate_delta_pct: 1.5
  latency_p50_rel_pct: 20
  consecutive_checks: 2
  min_requests_per_check: 1000
regions: 
  - global
  - regional_rollbacks_allowed: true
```

devin: @jordan can you confirm SLO numbers for enterprise so I can put them in the table? Also, is the manual sign-off workflow ok for 25%?

jordan: Confirmed: enterprise p99 <= 400ms, error_rate <= 0.5% overall. Manual sign-off at 25% is fine. Add an action item for SEs to ack tenants pinned to variants before 25%.

elaine: For experiment design, we should also capture the observability checklist: dashboards for model-level token cost, per-tenant error breakdown, hallucination-signal alert (eval-run mismatch > 5%), and rollback audit trail.

maya: Perfect. I'll update PRD and create a short RFC for the runbook. Action items:
- maya: update PRD with thresholds + YAML example (today)
- devin: add automation for tiebreaker logic in router (spec + unit tests) by EOW
- jordan: confirm SE ack flow and notify customer-facing teams (tomorrow)
- elaine: add observability dashboards and ensure webhook for rollback audit (next week)

deploy-bot: Canary rollout job scheduled: tenant-priority-experiment -> start 2024-11-02T14:00Z (automated checks enabled).

maya: Thanks all — I'll push PRD draft to the product folder and ping for final review before Thursday. :thumbsup:
